findings: XDIE-HBM4: production-P reduce steps MEASURED (v8g AR_ITER 1 + ROWS 128): qw_rs16 229 cyc (composed 229, delta +0), qw_rs32 281 cyc (composed 281, delta +0), qw_rs64 385 cyc (composed 385, delta +0), ds_rs48 662 cyc (composed 662, delta +0). The XDIE-HBM3 composition RS(P) = AG(P) + [RS(4) - AG(4)] + (P - 4) is confirmed cycle-exact.

XDIE-HBM4: iterated tags alone do not fit 64 rows (rs16 96 -> 82, rs32..64 117 -> 95 rows): the RX fill (~27 rows: the 27-edge per-frame span VM re-read -> DEL0) + drain (~20) + TX (~41) exceed 64; the 128-row issuer is what makes RS(P >= 16) one programme. Issuer leaf (ot_hgi_coll_issuer_m: 3 -> 6 64x512 macros, 128:1 reads), fj programme target leaves and the v8g parent need re-gate at ROWS 128 / AR_ITER 1 (not submitted).

XDIE-HBM4 item 3 (delivery-offset edge) CLOSED: the ctl_v5 delivery_obase pin lands on the DEL0 valid edge when the compiler programs del_obase ONE row after the sink row (--del-edge 1); with the offset CHECKED (+ADRCHK) qa_ag16 / qa_rs64 / qa_rs32 / qa_rs16 / da_rs48 / da_ag48 PASS with adr_bad 0/0 and the same E; the del-edge-0 programme FAILS under the check (m_adr0). Compiler fix, no RTL change (step_cosim4/adr).

A production-P reduce step does not fit one 64-row static_issuer_v6 programme: AR fields (load/read/pub tags, pub_index) have no iteration step, so a loop body must span the tag lifetime (load -> pub_issue 12 edges -> >= 7 tags, 14+ rows) and prologue/epilogue are ~27 rows each: rs8 needs 70 rows, rs16 96, rs64 117 (compiler capacity assert). AG steps fit (64 frames: 50 rows) with iterated link seq / VM sector / delivery offset. Fix options: iterate reduce tags (tag + iteration mod 16) or a second programme bank.
reduce_static accepts one operand edge per frame operand: a 2-operand reduce step drains at 0.5 frame/edge while the link delivers 0.8 frame/beat -- the RS step is reduce-bound, not link-bound.

XDIE-HBM5: DS AG(144) MEASURED as one static programme with 3 RX pingpong blocks (48 each): E 760 cyc (d1 754) vs composed 739.4 (+20.6); bit-exact 144/144 both dies; mutants nogap / vmstep REJECTED. 96 issuer rows (ROWS 128).

XDIE-HBM5: RS(144) 3-block does NOT fit the 128-row issuer (~214 rows even with local loads back to back): every block bubble (pingpong FLUSH before the next release) unrolls ~33 rows of the 19-row peer pipeline. Needs ROWS 256 or a nested-loop ISA -> COORD decision. RS(144) now composed from the MEASURED AG(144): 918 = AG(144) + [RS(48) - AG(48)] + 96.

HBM-COLL256-RS144: DS RS(144) MEASURED as one static programme (218 rows, 12 loops) on the 256-row COLL issuer: E 872 cyc (d0 862) vs composed 918 (-46); bit-exact 144/144 both dies, +ADRCHK; mutants nogap / vmstep REJECTED; reg ds_ag48 600 / ds_ag144 760 unchanged at ROWS 256. o-group RS(144)+AG(144) re-composed: measured-current-RTL 1012 -> 966.

HBM-COLL256-RS144: mb_plan holds block b > 0 link reads by 5k beats and assumes no TX IDLE beat inside the step; the launch gearbox phase therefore matters (T0 16000 -> gc 163 -> IDLE beat at ~rel 205 -> TX calendar fault in the A stage). The bench launches at gc 116 (T0 = 9000 + 8 x 1021 edges); a production compiler must place the IDLE beat (or launch phase) explicitly.
